title: Rigidity and Morse index of free boundary minimal $T$-surfaces in the unit ball
summary: We study regular two-dimensional free boundary minimal $T$-surfaces in the unit ball $\B^n$, with six faces, four triple junction arcs, and one tetrahedral vertex. A conformal minimal immersion of the standard flat $T$-cone, with the prescribed matching of junction traces, has the flat cone as its image. We also obtain rigidity criteria that do not require matching conformal parametrizations. In the disk-type class, two opposite planar faces suffice.
